name: rea-video
description: Reverse-engineer a video shot by shot: live action, AI, 3D, code-rendered or screen capture, plus editing, sound, real footage, special moments and a remake plan. 逆向拆解视频，给出复刻方案。

interface.shortDescription: See how a video was made and get a remake plan / 拆解视频怎么做的，给出复刻方案
interface.longDescription: Judges each shot (live action, AI-generated, 3D, code-rendered, screen capture and more), breaks down captions, sound and real footage, and writes a remake plan. For magic and story videos it also finds reveals, twists and mistakes, with frame-by-frame strips and slow motion. Needs the rea-video CLI (bash scripts/install_skill.sh). 逐镜头判断制作方式，拆字幕、声音和真实素材，给出复刻方案。需要本机装好 rea-video CLI。
defaultPrompt: Use rea-video to break down how this video was made: ~/Movies/ref.mp4
用 rea-video 拆解这条视频是怎么做的：~/Movies/ref.mp4
这条魔术视频是怎么变的？找出揭秘时刻：~/Movies/magic.mp4
